description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring slender ant body with a tall forehead horn facing vertically closing jaws.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：细蚁体头顶竖高角，与垂直闭合颚相对。

scientific_scope.en: Provisional genus-level reconstruction proposal; the supplied source supports context or partial form, and detailed anatomy remains gated.
scientific_scope.zh: 暂定属级复原方案；来源支持背景或局部形态，详细解剖须通过参考审核。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is slender ant body with a tall forehead horn facing vertically closing jaws; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以细蚁体头顶竖高角，与垂直闭合颚相对为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish slender ant body with a tall forehead horn facing vertically closing jaws in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以细蚁体头顶竖高角，与垂直闭合颚相对搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: Sources currently support the broader group or partial anatomy; the proposed genus-specific silhouette and period must be checked against an identified specimen or primary figure before production.
reference_notes: The era is a representative planning interval, not a full stratigraphic range or a coexistence claim. Verify the selected species, locality and specimen before a place-specific scene.

sources.title: New haidomyrmecine ants from mid-Cretaceous amber of northern Myanmar
sources.supports: Haidomyrmecine fossil ants, including specialized mandibles; exact Ceratomyrmex horn proportions require matching primary figures.
